opponent.label: Meia Gisborn
opponent.artist: spnanon, Hologic, Vortex00, Halo, thelonelyphonebox, Onboro
opponent.description: The young, cool, and collected Chief Pilot of the Dread fighters that defend the starship Nirvana, crewed by pirates from the all-female colony of Mejare. Beneath her stoic exterior lies a burning desire to prove herself---and to understand men.

costume.costume-description: Meia dressed as a Cupid from Monster Girl Encyclopedia. Suggested for Cupids being similarly known for their loveless stoicism.
Meia in a one-piece bathing suit and goggles, having just finished swimming. Based on several pieces of promotional art.
Meia in the chemise she sleeps in. Loose and simple, it's perfect for when you're brooding in your quarters. Appears in Episode 6.
